desc.en: Allama Kafmi has written this dua in his book Misbah, on the authority of Imam Ali ibne Abi Talib who learned it from the Holy Prophet. The Holy Prophet said: "Allah will have mercy on him who keeps this dua as a taawiz, and recites it a great deal. He will forgive his sins and the sins of parents and his children, bestow on him countless blessings, keep him safe from misfortunes, multiply his earnings, and cure his ailments. "To improve and develop memory write the (Arabic) text of this dua on a clean piece of paper with saffron, wash it with pure water and drink it. Hang the written (Arabic) text of this dua (like a taawiz) around the neck of children to keep them safe from wild and poisonous animals, and the evil of witchcraft and jinn. It is reported that at the time of meraj the Holy Prophet (a) saw this dua written at the last post, qaaba qawsayn aw adna. Allah (swt) informed him that whosoever recites this heavenly dua or keeps it written version on his person, will get countless blessings…
desc.rurdu: Allama Kafmi ne apni kitaab Misbah mein, Imam Ali (a) se riwaayat ki hai keh unho ne Rasoole Khuda (s) se suna keh, Allah (swt) us shakhs par rahem karega jo is dua ko taawiz ke taur par apne paas rakkhega aur is dua ka padhna bada ajr rakhta hai. Padhne waale ke gunah, uske maa-baap aur aulaad ke gunah bakhsh diye jaayenge, us par be-shumaar ne’mate’n naazil hongi, bala’o se mehfooz rahega, uski soonne ki quwwat badh jaayegi aur bimaari se shifa milegi. Yaad daasht ko behtar aur us mein izaafe ke liye is dua ko Arabic mein ek saaf kaagaz par zaafran se likh kar, us kaagaz ko paani se dho kar woh paani ko pee le. Is dua ko Arabic mein likh kar bachcho’n ki gardan mein baandhe, jisse woh wehshi aur zehrile jaanwaro’n se mehfooz rahega, aur jaadugar aur jinnaato’n ke sharr se bhi. Riwaayat mein hai keh, jab Rasoole Khuda (s) meraj par gaye to unho ne is dua ko aakhri hadd (qaaba qawsayn aw adna) par likkha huwa dekha. Allah (swt) ne unhe farmaaya keh jo koi is jannati dua ko padhe ya taawiz ke taur par apne paas rakkhe to usey be-shumaar ne’mate’n ataa hongi…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَللّٰھُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَسْئَلُكَ یَا مَنْ اَقَرَّ لَهٗ بِالْعُبُوْدِیَّۃِ كُلُّ مَعْبُوْدِ یَا مَنْ یَحْمَدُهٗ كُلُّ مَحْمُوْدِ یَا مَنْ یَفْزَعُ اِلَیْهِ كُلُّ مَجْهُوْدِ یَا مَنْ یَطْلَبُ عِنْدَهٗ كُلُّ مَفْقُوْدِ یَا مَنْ سَآئِلُهٗ غَیْرُ مَرْدُوْدِ یَا مَنْ بَابُهٗ عَنْ سُؤَالِهٖ غَیْرُ مَسْدُوْدِ یَا مَنْ هُوَ غَیْرُ مَوْصُفِ وَلَا مَحْدُوْدِ۔

trans.en: O Allah I beseech You. O He with whom remain firmly attached all the worshippers, O He before whom all the praiseworthy bow down and pay tribute, O He unto whom all the tired and the oppressed cry for help, O He who is besought for fulfillment of needs by all those who are deprived, O He who does not send away any supplicant disappointed, O He whose door is never shut up for the beseechers, O He who is indescribable and indefinable.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: یَا مَنْ عَطَآؤُهٗ غَیْرُ مَمْنُوْعِ وَلَا مَنْكُوْدِ یَا مَنْ هُوَ لِمَنْ دَعَاهُ لَیْسَ بِبَعِیْدِ وَهُوَ نِعْمَ الْمَقْصُوْدُ یَا مَنْ رَجَآئُ عِبَادِهٖ بِحَبْلِهٖ مَشْدُوْدٌ یَا مَنْ شِبْهُهٗ وَمِثْلُهٗ غَیْرُ مَوْجُوْدِ یَا مَنْ لَیْسَ بِوَالِدِ وَلَا مَوْلُوْدِ یَا مَنْ كَرَمُهٗ وَفَضْلُهٗ لَیْسَ بِمَعْدُوْدِ۔

trans.en: O He in whose bestowals there is no let-up, and they are not little nor scanty, O He who is not out of the reach of prayers; and is the best destination, O He whose servants tie their hopes with (His) rope, O He like unto whom, there is no one, and no one is comparable to Him, O He who was not begotten, nor begets, O He whose bounties and favours are innumerable.

arabic.text: یَا مَنْ حَوْضُ بِرِّهٖ لِلْاَنَامِ مَوْرُوْدِ یَا مَنْ لَا یُوْصَفُ بِقِیَامِ وَلَا قُعُوْدِ یَا مَنْ لَا تَجْرِیْ عَلَیْهِ حَرْكَۃٌ وَلَا جَمُوْدٌ یَا اللهُ یَا رَحْمٰنُ یَا رَحِیْمُ یَا وَدُوْدُ یَا رَاحِمِ الشَّیْخِ الْكَبِیْرِ یَعْقُوْبَ یَاغَافِرَ ذَنْبِ دَاؤُدَ۔

trans.en: O He whose overflowing reservoir of good is kept open for mankind, O He to whom standing up (wakefulness) and sitting down (rest) cannot be attributed, O He who urges his gifts and presents to reach the created beings, O He who is not circumstanced by movement or stillness (inaction), O Allah, O beneficent, O merciful, O loving friend, O He who took pity on the aging Yaqub, O He who overlooked the mistake of Dawood.

arabic.text: یَا مَنْ لَا یُخْلِفُ الْوَعْدَ وَیَعْفُوَ عَنِ الْمَوْعُوْدِ یَا مَنْ رِزْقَهٗ وَسِتْرُهٗ لِلْعَاصِیْنَ مَمْدُوْدٌ یَا مَنْ هُوَ مَلْجَائُ كُلِّ مُقْصَی مَطْرُوْدِ یَا مَنْ دَانَ لَهٗ جَمِیْعُ خَلْقِهٖ بِالسُّجُوْدِ یَا مَنْ لَیْسَ عَنْ نَیْلِهٖ وَجُوْدِهٖ اَحَدٌ مَصْدُوْدٌ یَا مَنْ لَا یَحِیْفُ فِیْ حُكْمِهٖ وَیَحْلُمُ عَنِ الظَّالِمِ الْحَنُوْدِ اِرْحَمْ عُبَیْدَا خَاطِئَا لَمْ یُوْفِ بِالْعُهُوْدِ اِنَّكَ فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا تُرِیْدُ۔

trans.en: O He who does not break His word and forgives those whom forgiveness has been assured, O He who gives livelihood and covers the misdeeds of the creatures to their full satisfaction, O He who gives asylum to all the persecuted victims of revenge, O He to come nearer to whom all creatures lay with the face downward on the ground in abject submission, O He from whose beneficence not a single (living) soul is kept away, O He who does not rule unjustly, nor shows mercy to the headstrong tryants, have mercy on the petty transgressors who did not carry out their obligations. Verily You do whatever You will.

arabic.text: یَا بَارٌ یَا وَدُوْدُ صَلِّ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ خَیْرِ مَبْعُوْثِ دَعٰی اِلٰی خَیْرِ مَعْبُوْدِ وَعَلٰی اِلٰهِ الطَّیِّبِیْنَ الطَّاهِرِیْنَ اَهْلِ الْكَرَمِ وَالْجُوْدِ وَافْعَلْ بِنَا مَا اَنْتَ اَهْلُهٗ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ یَا اَكْرَمَ الْاَكْرَمِیْنَ۔

trans.en: O Truthful, O Loving, send blessings on Muhammad, the best Messenger, who called attention (of all) to the best worshippable, and on his descendants, pious, pure, generous and liberal, and do well for me as it is worthy of You, O the most merciful, O the most generous.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
